score_label: Indicative Model Score (Provisional Candidate Extraction — Subject to Peer Review)
missing_policy: Preserve null; omit its contribution without renormalizing weights. Suppress score below 75% weighted coverage. This is a partial weighted sum, not a full-data estimate.
tie_rule: Equal displayed scores retain canonical register order; no percentile or reference validation is computed.
limitations: Target values and rock/ice encodings are unverified model assumptions, not extracted observations.
Temperature contrasts, terrain scales, rainfall periods and aerosol wavelengths may be incompatible across bodies.
Feature coverage counts model inputs, not verified scientific measurements.
Candidate map positions remain provisional and do not authorize spatial extraction.
